action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Bojats makes two shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
